tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// dag snang gsang ba'i skor las/ rigs 'dus tshe sgrub pad+ma'i rgya can bzhugs so//

rdor brag rig 'dzin bdun pa kun bzang 'gyur med lhun 'grub dag snang*/ na mo ā yur de ba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ kho bo rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku'i mtshan tsam 'dzin pa kun bzang 'gyur med lhun grub tu 'bod pa'i bhu su ku pa bdag /shing glang sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcu'i snga char tshe sgrub sku gsum rigs 'dus kyi bzlas thun skabs/ nam mkha' nas sngags kyi rang sgra grags pa'i rkyen gyis snang ba zi bun du song nas chang gis myos pa lta bu'i nyams snang la/ gu ru rin po che mngon rtogs dang mthun par mjal bas dbang bskur ba'i nyams dang*/ de'i mdun mtsho rgyal bod mo'i rnam pa can phyag na pi waṃ bsnams pa'i sgra dang lhan cig gdams pa 'di ltar du bstsal ba'i nyams shar ro// kye hoḥmakha' 'gro'i bu khyod nyon: snyigs dus tshe la bar chad mang: khyad par dam tshig nyams grib kyis: glo bur 'chi ba 'byung srid pas: gu ru rje la gsol ba thobs: zab mo'i gdams pa 'di ltar sgoms: skyabs sems mchod pa byin gyis brlab: rlung ro bsal zhing 'jam rlung gzung: rig pa stong gsal brjod med ngang: skad cig dran rdzogs lha skur gsal: a: rang byung ye shes rol pa'i rtsal: pad+ma tshe yi zhing khams su: rdo rje'i srung 'khor sra zhing brtan: tshe yi pho brang 'od du 'bar: de dbus sna tshogs rdo rje dang: lcags kyi pad nyi zla ba'i dbus: rig pa rang byung gnyug ma'i lha: ma hā gu ru tshe dbang rtsal: dmar gsal zhi 'dzum khro bo'i nyams: phyag g.yas rdo rje mda' dar g.yab: g.yon pas dril bu tshe bum bsnams: pad zhwa gsang phod snam sbyar gsol: za hor smug ber brjid ldan bklubs: rdo rje'i skyil krung drang por bzhugs: spyi bor pad zla'i gdan gyi steng: snang mtha' dmar gsal chos gos gsol: mnyam gzhag bdud rtsi'i lhung bzed 'dzin: thugs kar longs sku tshe dpag med: dbang mdog mnyam gzhag rgyas tshe bum: gos dkar mda' dar bum 'dzin 'khyud:

gnyis ka dar dang rin chen brgyan: rdo rje pad+ma'i skyil krung gis: pad zla rgyas pa'i dbus na rol: gzhan yang rtsa khams thams cad kun: rab 'byams tshe lha'i ngo bor gsal: gnas gsum 'bru gsum rgyas btab pa'i: 'od kyis ye shes spyan drangs bsam: hrī: pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas: ma hā gu ru tshe dbang rtsal: rtsa gsum tshe lha rab 'byams bcas: gnas 'dir badz+ra sa mā dza: rdo rje'i gdan la tiṣ+ṭha lhan: gnyis med gus pas brda phyag 'tshal: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dngos 'byor yid sprul nyer spyod dang: 'dod yon sman raka gtor ma'i tshogs: bde chen longs spyod chen por 'bul: tshe dang ye shes dngos grub stsol: ma hā sarba pū dza sa ma ya ho: pañtsa a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi: hrī: snang ba mtha' yas tshe dpag med: ma hā gu ru tshe yi lha: sku gsum rigs 'dus bla ma la: gus pas bstod do dngos grub stsol: thugs ka'i tshe dpag med mgon gyi: thugs dbus gnam lcags rdo rje'i sbubs: hrīḥdamar 'od zer lcags kyu yis: 'khor 'das tshe bcud 'ubs kyis bsdus: rdo rje'i srog rtsa 'grub par bsam: sna sgo'i rlung gnyis nar gyis drangs: 'jam rlung ngang nas dbyings rig bsre: thugs srog yid bzlas tshe gcig bya: hrīḥhrīḥhrī: de nas bsnyen sgrub sngags 'di bzla: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru ā yur+dzñā na sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: 'bu phrag bzhi yis rtags mthong 'gyur: thun mthar tshe 'gugs mchod cing bstod: nongs bshags lha sku dbyings su bsdu: thun mtshams lhar ldang bsngo smon dang: bkra shis brjod cing spyod lam bskyang: rdzogs rim nam mkha' dwangs pa'i dus: shar du kha bltas lus gnad bsrang: 'byung bzhi'i dwangs ma nam mkhar thim: mkha' bcud 'od zer mthing ga'i tshul: kha nas drangs shing bum can gzung: rig pa skye 'chi bral ba'i ngang: ka dag gting gsal rjen par bzhag: rnam rtog 'gyu 'phro gang byung yang: rang rig ngang du 'dzin med khyer:

rang don dngos grub blang ba dang: gzhan la tshe yi dbang bskur na: dkyil 'khor sgrub rdzas tshogs par bsham: bsnyen sgrub nus ldan sngon song nas: maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba gdab: rgyud sbyang lhar bskyed ye shes dbab: brtan par bya zhing tshe yang dgug: hrī: bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med: 'byung ba lnga la dbang sgyur lha mo'i tshogs: rnal 'byor bdag gi tshe dang g.yang spel cig: steng 'og phyogs bcu snod kyi 'jig rten la: bros dang 'khyams dang yar pa'i tshe khug cig: stong phrag brgyad cu bgegs kyi tshogs rnams kyis: brkus dang phrogs dang gzhom pa'i tshe khug cig: 'byung ba'i dgra gshed 'khrugs pa'i las sbyor gyis: nyams dang zad dang thor pa'i tshe gsos shig: yed kyis dngangs dang had kyis brgyal ba dang: 'ud kyis 'drogs pa'i tshe dang g.yang gsos shig: tshe khug g.yang skyobs dngos grub bstsal du gsol: 'byung lnga 'od lnga 'bar ba'i tshe bcud stims: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub bdag la stsol: ces dang sngags brjod do// de nas tshe 'brang spyi bor bzhag: tshe lha rig 'dzin brgyud pa la: gsol ba gdab cing dbang bskur bsam: hrī: mgon po tshe dpag med pa'i dgongs pa yis: sogs nas/ gsol ba 'debs: tshe dang ye shes 'chi med dbang bskur stsol: sngags brjod/ tshe rdzas dga' ston longs spyod bya: hrī: rdo rje tshe yi ril bu dang: 'chi med byang sems bdud rtsi'i bcud: bde ba chen po'i longs spyod kyis: tshe dang ye shes rgyas par shog: sngags brjod/ tshe bcud bstim zhing rgyas gdab bya: a: stong pa'i go cha bla na med: ye shes dbyings su tshe sbas pas: sangs rgyas rnams kyis mi gzigs na: bar chad bgegs kyis lta ci smros: badz+ra ā yu ṣe dzñā na a a: bkra shis rjes chog spyi ltar bya: gzhan yang phyi nang bcud len dang: tshogs mchod me mchod la sogs pa: rten 'brel rim par rtag tu 'bad:

lo re bzhin du srog bslu dang: sāts+tsha gdab cing lam 'phrang bcos: gdams pa zab mo 'di nyid kyang: shin tu gsang zhing rang nyams blang: ྈྈྈྈྈྈ bka' rgyas gdab: rang gzhan tshe yi gsos su 'gyur: kho mo'i tha tshig las ma 'dor: snying la phur cig sa ma ya: zhes gsungs nas gu ru mtsho rgyal dang: de nyid rang la thim pa'i mod nyams sad 'phral zin bris su btab pa sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gu h+ya: rda thim: ༈ 'di'i brgyud pa rig 'dzin kun bzang 'gyur med lhun 'grub nas/ rje btsun kun bzang 'jigs med bde chen/ 'gyur med mthu stobs rnam rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po/ des so/// /
